description: Plan a complete robot joint from targets: peak torque, output speed, bus voltage, mass budget and quantity. Returns complete joint actuators that meet the targets, and joints built from parts (frameless motor + reducer + driver + encoder) with the torque and speed math shown, listed price and mass totals, which parts still need a quote, lead times where known and where each part is made. Checks the catalog cannot make are reported as not checked.

max_mass_g.description: Mass budget for the joint, g

peak_torque_nm.description: Peak output torque the joint needs, N·m

speed_rpm.description: Output speed the joint needs, rpm

name: plan_joint

error.description: Set when the tool could not answer; the other fields are then absent.

title: Plan a robot joint
